title: FODA-FCP: fuzzy-ontology diagnostic analysis for microservices

creators.name: Mirzazada, Allahshukur
creators.affiliation: Azerbaijan State Oil and Industry University

description:
Software, per-case results and supplements for FODA-FCP, a knowledge-based root-cause analysis method for microservices that derives a fuzzy fault hypothesis for each service from rules with certainty factors, propagates confidence over a service graph, and explains the ranking with an OWL 2 diagnostic ontology.

The repository contains the evaluated implementation, the harness for the RCAEval RE1 benchmark, the scripts and per-case result files behind the reported tables (aggregation operators, weight normalisation, direction of propagation, inferred and trace-measured call graphs, saturation bounds, explanation measures), and the generated supplement docs/kes2027_supplement.md. RESULTS_PROVENANCE.md records the commit and script behind each result file.
